page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 704.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.8 GB per vCPU.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its substantial bundled local storage, consisting of 19,198 GB of local SSD capacity. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the combination of dedicated compute resources, high memory density, and massive local SSD storage, this instance offers high resource density for data-intensive workloads. It is designed for applications requiring high-capacity local storage and substantial memory, such as large-scale relational databases, NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and big data analytics.
